description: Agent Labor Verification: submit worker classification evidence with the classification claimed: the claim with the worker, the classification claimed (employee or contractor) and the business engaging the worker; the evidence on five factors: control (whether the business sets the hours, directs the method, trains the worker and reviews the work), integration (core work, an ongoing engagement, supervising staff, a staff directory listing), exclusivity (other clients served, an exclusivity term, services marketed to the public), tools and equipment (who supplies them, reimbursed expenses) and pay structure (hourly, salary, per project, per invoice or commission, invoicing, benefits and withholding). The signed report gives the claim, each factor read from its indicators as pointing to employee or contractor treatment or mixed, each factor pointing away from the claim with the indicators behind it, and the evidence as a whole, and counts them, and names divergent evidence: three or more of the five factors pointing away from the classification claimed; then one or two factors pointing away, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Fewer than three factors stated leaves the rest unverified. A factor points where most of its stated indicators point and is mixed on a tie. The verdict reads the evidence supplied and decides nothing about anyone’s legal status. This reads the classification evidence for workers already engaged. Verdict labor_classification_divergent, labor_classification_partial, labor_classification_unverified or labor_classification_consistent. POST /api/labor-classification-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.

classification.description: The classification claimed: employee or contractor.

engaged_by.description: The business that engages the worker.

directs_method.description: The business directs how the work is done.

reviews_work.description: The business reviews the work as it is done.

sets_hours.description: The business sets the hours worked.

trains.description: The business trains the worker in its methods.

exclusive_clause.description: An agreement bars work for others.

markets_services.description: The worker markets services to the public.

other_clients.description: Other clients the worker serves in the period.

core_work.description: The work is part of the business’s core work.

in_staff_directory.description: The worker appears in the staff directory or org chart.

ongoing.description: The engagement is ongoing, with no end date.

supervises_others.description: The worker supervises the business’s staff.

invoices.description: The worker invoices for the work.

structure.description: How pay is structured: hourly, salary, per project, per invoice or commission.

expenses_reimbursed.description: The business reimburses the worker’s expenses.

supplied_by.description: Who supplies the tools and equipment: worker, business or both.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
